title: GPT-RAG hosted conversation capability v1
description: Disabled fallback owner-bound capability created, retained, and verified exclusively by the UI BFF when HOSTED_CONVERSATION_OWNER_BINDING=capability. The hosted container receives neither this envelope nor the HMAC key.

oid.description: Lowercase Microsoft Entra object ID derived by the UI BFF from the authenticated server-side principal.

conversation_resource_id.description: Opaque Foundry managed Conversation resource identifier.

issued_at.description: UTC Unix time in whole seconds when the UI BFF issued the capability.

expiry.description: UTC Unix time in whole seconds after which the capability must be rejected.

key_id.description: Non-secret identifier selecting the HMAC key version in the UI BFF Key Vault.

signature.description: Unpadded Base64URL HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical framing. The signature is excluded from the framed payload.

x-canonical-framing.algorithm: Begin with the exact ASCII domain separator followed by one NUL byte. For each field in field_order, append a 4-byte unsigned big-endian length followed by the field value bytes. Encode strings as UTF-8. Encode integers as their shortest base-10 ASCII representation with no sign and no leading zeroes except the value zero. Exclude signature. Sign the resulting bytes with HMAC-SHA256 and encode the digest as unpadded Base64URL.
x-canonical-framing.verification: Reject before use if the schema version is unsupported, framing is non-canonical, HMAC comparison is not constant-time, oid does not match the authenticated UI BFF principal, expiry is not greater than issued_at, or the capability is expired.
